# Test: effective config list falls back to git config for invalid TOML
setup_workspace

exec git config grove.preserve fallback.txt
cp $WORK/invalid.toml .grove.toml
exec grove config list
stderr -count=1 'Warning: failed to parse .grove.toml:.*using fallback'
stdout '^preserve.patterns=fallback.txt$'

this is not valid toml [[[
